title: VentureAtlasStrategicAsset
description: A reusable strategic asset created by one or more venture bets. Assets compound or decay — represent the difference. Do not conflate with code modules alone.

type.description: Class of strategic asset. Determines compounding behavior and redeployability.

sourceBetId.description: Bet ID that primarily created this asset.

reusability.description: How broadly this asset can be redeployed. Narrow assets bind you to one path.

redeployability.description: How easily this asset can be redirected to a different purpose.

compoundsOverTime.description: True if asset grows in value with use/time (audience, data, trust). False if it decays (API arbitrage, trend-dependent).

decayRate.description: Qualitative decay description. Some assets lose value quickly; others are durable.

linkedIdeaIds.description: Canonical idea IDs that benefit from this asset. Enables reverse pathfinding: given asset, which ideas become attractive?

reducesEntryBarrierFor.description: Bet IDs where this asset materially reduces cost or time.

strategicValue.description: Qualitative strategic value. Avoid fake precision.
